payload.title: Your WeBank loan can't fund Singapore
payload.message: Your WeBank business loan is for your business in China. Moving it into the Singapore shop would break the loan's terms.
payload.consequence: WeBank could ask for the loan back early, and the ODI filing could be refused.

source.label: 互联网贷款管理暂行办法 Art. 24(三) and Art. 30; 流动资金贷款管理办法 (2024) Art. 9
